title: Monitoring integration consumes the probe JSON body without hand-parsing HTML
asA: third-party monitoring integration or dashboard consuming the application's probe endpoints
iWant: a stable JSON response shape from both probes with stable field names and an ISO-8601 timestamp on every response
soThat: I wire the integration once and it does not break when a patch release ships

acceptanceCriteria.description: Both probe responses declare Content-Type application/json; both bodies parse as JSON and contain a status field (pass or fail) and a checkedAt field with a parseable ISO-8601 timestamp.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is running and both probes are reachable
acceptanceCriteria.when: GETs are issued against each probe path and each response body is JSON-parsed
acceptanceCriteria.then: each response has Content-Type application/json, each body parses without error, each parsed body has a status field valued pass or fail, and each body has a checkedAt field that parses as a valid ISO-8601 date-time

acceptanceCriteria.description: The readiness body carries a checks object keyed by declared dependency name; the liveness body has no checks field. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the elicited declared-dependency-set; the AC substitutes the project's dependency names for the illustrative paymentsProvider / primaryStore tokens.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process has declared a readiness dependency set and both probes are reachable
acceptanceCriteria.when: the two probe response bodies are compared
acceptanceCriteria.then: the readiness body contains a checks object with one entry per declared readiness dependency, and the liveness body contains no checks field

acceptanceCriteria.description: The probe response JSON body shape is snapshot-locked against the v2 baseline captured at 2026-09-09: any candidate release comparing against the current v2 baseline SHALL keep every documented field name and JSON type on the /live and /ready responses, and any field addition SHALL preserve the shape of every earlier v2.x release. A candidate that renames or removes a documented field fails the check with a stable code naming the offending field. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the elicited liveness-probe-path; the AC substitutes it for the illustrative /live.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the v2 baseline snapshot at packages/rcf-lite/test/blueprint/observability-essentials-response-baseline.v2.json and a candidate release's /live and /ready JSON body samples on the same profile
acceptanceCriteria.when: the release-time compatibility check runs the candidate samples against the v2 baseline snapshot
acceptanceCriteria.then: every field name and JSON type present on the v2 baseline is present on the candidate at the same top-level path; a rename or removal fails with the stable code PROBE_BODY_SHAPE_DRIFT naming the offending field; a candidate that adds fields without renaming or removing any passes
